newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Vision gets $20 million credit.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Vision gets $20 million credit.

text.p: Sterling Vision Inc said Tuesday it had entered into a new, $20-million credit facility with a unit of Sun Trust Bank.
The company, which runs a chain of retail optical stores, said in a statement that it got the credit from S.T.I. Credit Corp, a subsidiary of the bank.
It said it had secured it primarily by existing franchisee promissory notes receivable.
The company said it used proceeds from the first advance to pay off debt owed to Chase Manhattan Corp, which has offered to extend to it a new, $5-million line of credit.
